name: sprint-delivery
description: Work a sprint validation-first AND end-to-start. DISCOVER going down: test STAGE (the exact deployed build, pointed at the deployed backend) and capture what needs implementing, then test DEV (dev branch built on the simulator, dev backend) and capture more — combine those findings with the planned TODO tickets into one work-list. IMPLEMENT locally: per ticket, reproduce → confirm it's real (judge-reproducibility) — unconfirmed tickets bounce before any code — → implement→verify in a bounded loop (judge-convergence). INTEGRATE going back up: merge to dev, re-test dev, then a HUMAN go/no-go before a canary deploy that re-tests stage against the freshly deployed build, with auto-rollback. The READ-ONLY QA (testing each environment across components, and the blast-radius sweep) fans out in parallel capped at a pool of 3 (sims/workers) via map concurrency; the IMPLEMENT step stays serial (parallel file-edits on one working tree would conflict). The environment-adapter switches branch/build/backend for each layer so every test hits the right thing.

inputs.name: todoTickets
inputs.description: The planned sprint tickets (the TODO list). Combined with what testing stage + dev surfaces to form the work-list. Empty = work only what the environment testing finds.

phases.name: discover-stage
phases.description: Test the HIGHEST environment first — stage, exactly as users will hit it.

phases.name: prep-stage
phases.prompt: Prepare TARGET stage: use the EXACT build currently deployed (the same artifact shipped via the release/Xcode process — do not rebuild from source) and point the client at the deployed stage backend.

phases.name: test-stage
phases.description: Test each component on the deployed stage build/backend IN PARALLEL, capped to a pool of 3 (sims/workers). Read-only QA — safe to parallelize.

body.name: qa-stage-component
body.prompt: Run QA + the key journeys for the ${item} component on STAGE (deployed build, deployed backend). List every defect or gap that needs implementation, most severe first.

phases.name: discover-dev
phases.description: Then the dev branch, built on the simulator against the dev backend.

phases.name: prep-dev
phases.prompt: Prepare TARGET dev: check out the dev branch, build it on the simulator, and point the client at the dev backend.

phases.name: test-dev
phases.description: Test each component on the dev build IN PARALLEL, capped to a pool of 3 (sims/workers).

body.name: qa-dev-component
body.prompt: Run QA for the ${item} component on the DEV build (dev branch on the simulator, dev backend). List every defect or gap, most severe first.

phases.name: assemble-worklist
phases.description: Combine what stage + dev testing surfaced with the planned TODO tickets into one deduplicated work-list.

phases.name: deliver-local
phases.description: Switch to a local working branch, then work each ticket: reproduce → confirm → implement→verify.

phases.name: prep-local
phases.prompt: Prepare TARGET local: cut a working branch off dev, build locally, point at the dev (or local) backend.

phases.name: extract-worklist
phases.description: Robustly pull the JSON array out of the planner's reply (tolerant of prose/fences) so the map can iterate it.

code.source: const raw = String(state.worklistRaw || ''); const m = raw.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/); if (!m) return '[]'; try { return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(m[0])); } catch { return '[]'; }

phases.name: reproduce
phases.description: Reproduce the ticket's reported behavior locally before spending fix effort.

phases.name: confirm-gate
phases.description: Only CONFIRMED defects proceed to implementation; the rest bounce out before any code is written.

confirmed.name: implement
confirmed.description: Reproduced → fix it, looping until QA passes or judge-convergence calls it (oscillating/stalled tickets stop and escalate).

phases.name: fix
verify

cannot-reproduce.name: bounce-back
cannot-reproduce.description: Couldn't reproduce — request steps from the reporter. Do NOT implement.

inconclusive.name: human-triage
inconclusive.description: Ambiguous reproduction — a human decides whether to implement or bounce.

phases.name: merge-dev
phases.description: Merge the confirmed-and-fixed tickets to the dev branch (reversible — no human gate here).

phases.name: retest-dev
phases.description: Go back UP: re-test dev with the fixes integrated, against the dev backend.

phases.name: prep-dev-again
phases.prompt: Prepare TARGET dev: rebuild the dev branch (now with the merged fixes) on the simulator, dev backend.

phases.name: qa-dev-again
phases.description: Re-run QA across components on the integrated dev build IN PARALLEL (pool of 3) — the blast-radius sweep after merge.

body.name: retest-component
body.prompt: Re-run QA for the ${item} component on the integrated DEV build (with the merged fixes). Confirm the fixed tickets pass and nothing in ${item} regressed.

phases.name: promote-to-stage
phases.description: After the dev retest, gate on dev being green: merge dev into the stage branch, BUILD the stage app on the simulators, then QA that freshly built stage build. Only a green dev promotes; a red/unclear dev holds for a human before any merge to stage.

ship.name: stage-promotion
ship.description: Dev tests passed — promote to the stage line.

phases.name: merge-to-stage
phases.description: Dev is green — merge the dev branch into the stage branch (the promotion to the stage line).

phases.name: build-stage-on-sims
phases.prompt: Prepare TARGET stage: check out the stage branch (now carrying the merged dev fixes) and BUILD it on the simulators, pointed at the deployed stage backend.

phases.name: test-stage-build
phases.description: QA each component on the freshly built stage app on the simulators IN PARALLEL (pool of 3) — confirm the merged fixes hold on the real stage build before the release gate.

body.name: qa-stage-built-component
body.prompt: Run QA + key journeys for the ${item} component on the freshly BUILT STAGE app (stage branch built on the simulator, stage backend). Confirm the merged fixes hold and nothing regressed; list any defect most-severe first.

hold.name: hold-before-stage
hold.description: Dev retest not green — a human reviews before any merge to stage.

default.name: hold-before-stage-default
default.description: Unclear dev health — hold before merging to stage.

phases.name: release-readiness
phases.description: Compile the evidence into a go/no-go. The irreversible boundary is next — be skeptical.

phases.name: human-approval
phases.description: HITL gate: a human reads the readiness report and approves the deploy before anything irreversible runs.

phases.name: deploy-canary
phases.description: Deploy the integrated build to stage/prod as a canary (this becomes the new 'exact deployed build').

phases.name: retest-stage
phases.description: Re-test stage against the freshly deployed build + deployed backend — close the end-to-start loop.
phases.prompt: Re-test STAGE against the just-deployed canary build and the deployed backend. Report health: do the fixed tickets hold and do the key journeys pass?

phases.name: canary-decision
phases.description: Healthy → promote; regressed → automatic rollback.

promote.name: complete-rollout
promote.description: Canary healthy — record the release; rollout stands.

rollback.name: auto-rollback
rollback.description: Canary regressed — roll back to last-known-good automatically.

default.name: rollback-default
default.description: Unclear canary health — fail safe and roll back.

hold.name: hold-release
hold.description: Not ready — a human reviews the blockers before any retry.
